package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
)

// Reject duplicates throughout the request before decoding any map. Preserve
// metadata as RawMessage so arbitrary integers and decimal tokens are not rounded.
func unique(decoder *json.Decoder, depth int) error {
	if depth > 128 {
		return errors.New("request depth")
	}
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch token {
	case json.Delim('{'):
		keys := map[string]bool{}
		for decoder.More() {
			token, err := decoder.Token()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			key, ok := token.(string)
			if !ok || keys[key] {
				return errors.New("duplicate key")
			}
			keys[key] = true
			if err := unique(decoder, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		token, err = decoder.Token()
		if err != nil || token != json.Delim('}') {
			return errors.New("object end")
		}
	case json.Delim('['):
		for decoder.More() {
			if err := unique(decoder, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		token, err = decoder.Token()
		if err != nil || token != json.Delim(']') {
			return errors.New("array end")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func collect() error {
	source, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, 1048577))
	if err != nil || len(source) > 1048576 {
		return errors.New("request limit")
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(source))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	if err := unique(decoder, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := decoder.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("trailing data")
	}
	var request map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(source, &request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(request) != 6 {
		return errors.New("request fields")
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"evidence_id", "environment", "tool", "tool_version"} {
		var identity string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(request[key], &identity); err != nil || identity == "" {
			return errors.New("request identity")
		}
	}
	var context, input map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(request["context"], &context); err != nil || context == nil {
		return errors.New("request context")
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(request["input"], &input); err != nil || len(input) != 1 {
		return errors.New("request input")
	}
	var mode string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(input["mode"], &mode); err != nil || (mode != "positive" && mode != "negative") {
		return errors.New("synthetic acquisition error")
	}
	value, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Collected bool   `json:"collected"`
		Present   bool   `json:"present"`
		Mode      string `json:"mode"`
	}{true, mode == "positive", mode})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	output := map[string]any{
		"value":   json.RawMessage(value),
		"context": request["context"],
		"request": map[string]json.RawMessage{
			"tool": request["tool"], "tool_version": request["tool_version"],
			"input": request["input"], "context": request["context"],
		},
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(output)
}

func main() {
	if collect() != nil {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}
